definitions.patch: 3 by 3 pixels, mean of the channels, read from a screenshot with the interface and the room ghosts hidden
definitions.ratio: (L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05) with L1 the larger relative luminance (WCAG contrast), 3 decimals
definitions.poolRatio: poolRatioWcag = (L_in + 0.05) / (L_out + 0.05); poolRatioLum = L_in / L_out; both for two blocks of the SAME tone class (class 0, the commonest cool tone): 'in' is the nearest such block to the pool, outside the halo (centre 125 units or more from the flame, so the halo's amber glow does not add), inside half the pool radius or 125 units whichever is larger; 'out' is the nearest such block to 140 units beyond the pool's edge, at the same distance from the window within about 30 percent. Also read with the halo hidden.

1280x800.method: idle wall rows 330..860 units, column means, 130-unit average minus 600-unit average; fadeRemoved: veil and edge shade switched off; within320: |x - 300| <= 320 units; the smoothing windows read the whole page and the figure keeps only the stated columns
